fields.label: Action Type
fields.help: The action to take if the condition is met.

fields.label: Condition
fields.help: A CEL condition that refers to a supported service resource, for example 'resource.management.autoUpgrade == false'.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: A human-friendly description of the constraint to display as an error message when the policy is violated.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: A human-friendly name for the constraint.

fields.label: Method Types
fields.help: A list of RESTful methods for which to enforce the constraint.

fields.label: Parent
fields.help: The parent of the resource, an organization.
